title: Technical Graphic Design Intern
note: Open to Industrial Design or Technical Graphic Design majors with junior standing by Fall 2027; focuses on 3D animation of architectural products.

facts.summary: Paid summer intern on Haworth's Architectural Solutions team at headquarters, part of a 12-week intern cohort.
facts.duties: Create 3D animations, exploded views and training content on wall systems, freestanding products and pods for dealers and installers; turn technical information into digital content.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's student in ID or technical graphic design, junior standing by Fall 2027; US work authorization; preferred CAD/3D (Inventor, Creo, AutoCAD), animation tools (SolidWorks Composer, Blender, 3ds Max), Adobe CC, portfolio.
facts.apply: Apply online through Haworth's careers posting.
